entries.0db8ed20caa99e3a: Over-the-Counter Drugs and Home Medicine Cabinet Products
entries.1cea0d06abf72470: The company conducts OEM business at Bonanza Co., Ltd.
entries.2a87eb04151b93ad: The business that manufactures and sells cosmetics and toiletries and purchases and sells cosmetic sundries, and forms the core of the group. In Japan, Noevir Co., Ltd. and Bonanza Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell cosmetics and toiletries and purchase and sell cosmetic sundries, and Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Tokiwa Medical Service Co., Ltd. purchase and sell cosmetics and other products. Overseas, subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Taiwan and China purchase and sell cosmetics and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥50,525 million, the largest among the reportable segments.
entries.37875f200cfbf2ee: Developed by Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., these products are sold mainly through wholesalers at drugstores and variety shops, and also sold face-to-face through dermatology clinics and medical institutions nationwide.
entries.3cd66af1c5574b28: Other business positioned as a business segment category not included in the reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,664 million.
entries.3d3f3e4ad2631704: Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells over-the-counter drugs such as cold medicines and throat lozenges, and sells them mainly through wholesalers to drugstores, pharmacies and medicine shops. Home medicine cabinet products are sold through Tokiwa Medical Service Co., Ltd. and agents.
entries.5f5e7451fcb23034: A holding company group centered on the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and foods, which also operates apparel and aviation-related businesses.
entries.8b3125006e40eda7: Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells foods such as nutritional supplements and functional drinks, and sells them mainly through wholesalers to retail stores and others. The company also conducts home medicine cabinet sales through Tokiwa Medical Service Co., Ltd. and agents, and consignment sales at Noevir Co., Ltd.
entries.a303cd6f19be5043: The business that manufactures and purchases and sells pharmaceuticals and foods. In Japan, Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells over-the-counter drugs, medicines for home medicine cabinets, quasi-drugs and foods, and Tokiwa Medical Service Co., Ltd. purchases and sells medicines for home medicine cabinets and other products. Noevir Co., Ltd. purchases and sells foods. Overseas, subsidiaries in the United States, Canada and Taiwan purchase and sell foods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥11,535 million.
entries.a9ac52557af8e0a2: Noevir Aviation Co., Ltd. conducts air transport, operation contracting, handling and hangar leasing businesses, and Japan Flight Safety Co., Ltd. conducts aircraft piloting training. Noevir Aviation Inc. in the United States purchases and sells aircraft and vessels and conducts air transport and other businesses.
entries.b4fddb6323f7d20c: At Noevir Co., Ltd., the company purchases and sells apparel and body fashion products.
entries.e32f685873f9fd42: Developed by Noevir Co., Ltd., these cosmetics are sold face-to-face through sales agents under consignment sales contracts. The main sales agent operates lesson-type salons called "Noevir Beauty Studio".
entries.e707668372370ec6: Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells quasi-drugs such as tonic drinks, and Tokiwa Medical Service Co., Ltd. purchases and sells them.
